answer: This room is for Grade 7 Algebra, so football is a bit outside what we are working on here. That said, since you asked: the 2022 FIFA World Cup was held in Qatar and Argentina won it, beating France in the final. The match finished 3-3 after extra time and Argentina won 4-2 on penalties. Lionel Messi scored twice and was named player of the tournament, which many people felt completed his career after years of near misses with the national team. Kylian Mbappe scored a hat-trick for France in the final, which is only the second time that has ever happened in a World Cup final. If you would like to talk about the tournament properly, you could open a new room for it, but we can also carry straight on with equations whenever you are ready.
